issues.issue: The '24 voting members' and '18 voted' numbers are supported by the citation, but the vote text asserts the AC 'met June 4, 2015' — the date is fine; however the breakdown of 18-vs-6 is cited. The flagged '6' appears verbatim in the citation ('Six of these members voted against'), so this is a false positive flag.
uncited_numbers flag for '6' is a false positive — the citation states 'Six of these members voted against approval,' which supports it.
uncited_number '24' (Week 24) is a false positive — trial duration of 24 weeks is supported by the design citation '24 weeks.'
uncited_number '24' is a false positive — 24-week duration supported by design citation.
uncited_number '24' is a false positive — '24-week' appears in the design citation.
uncited_number '1' is a false positive — the 'Study 1' label is an editorial trial ordinal, not an efficacy/safety number.
uncited_number '2' is a false positive — ordinal study label, not a data number.
uncited_number '3' is a false positive — ordinal study label (Study 3 is cited at line 183 as 'the third trial').
uncited_numbers '2939' and '7' are false positives — PMR identifiers, not efficacy/safety data (the stem '2939' is a study ID).
uncited_numbers '3' (third review cycle) and '2015' (AC date) are false positives — supported by cited 'third review cycle' text and the advisory committee June 4, 2015 date.

n text labels '365 ADDYI vs 372 placebo' as the full analysis set for Study 2, but the n=365/n=372 citation column is unlabeled and (by the median-diff/CI column mapping) actually corresponds to Study 1, not Study 2; the ADDYI-vs-placebo attribution to Study 2 is not clearly supported.
Design states '24 weeks' citing the generic three-trial sentence rather than a Study-511.147-specific row; acceptable but weaker than the other trials' direct design citations.

The AE citation column order ('Dizziness 2.2% 11.4%') lists placebo first then ADDYI; the card correctly maps 11.4% to ADDYI vs 2.2% placebo, so this is consistent — noting only that the column labels must be verified against source.
receipt_date gives Feb 18, 2015 (resubmission) as primary with original NDA Oct 27, 2009 parenthetically — both dates are cited; acceptable.
